raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

HiCache can reserve primary KV and one auxiliary pool before another pool's allocation or reclaim callback raises. Only the `None` result is currently rolled back, so that exception leaves host slots reserved even though no backup was queued.

## Modifications

Roll back the auxiliary allocations made by the current resolution call, then release the primary KV reservation at the controller boundary. Caller-provided allocations stay owned by the caller, and successfully queued operations keep their slots.

If a release callback also raises, drain the other reservations without retrying the failed release. Re-raise the original allocation error with the cleanup error as its cause.

## Accuracy Tests

Current head `c6415f75` merges main `25c3fd83` and passes the original checked-in pytest entry in the complete source checkout:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mem_pool_host.py -k TestHostPoolGroup
# 7 passed, 28 deselected, 2 subtests passed; no skips
```

The merge conflict was in sidecar source resolution. Keep main's `merge_source_transfers` call inside the allocation rollback boundary, preserving both combined source spans and exception cleanup. The original `TestHostPoolGroup` class is unchanged from `01424482`; main added one unrelated deselected test.

This run uses normally imported production modules, real Torch 2.14.1 CPU tensors and the original test class/base, with no source or test-class extraction and no author-supplied module stub. The tests cover primary/auxiliary rollback, caller-owned reservations, cleanup error chaining, reclaim order and ownership after successful enqueue. Scoped Ruff, format and diff checks pass.

The existing private CPU overlay was reused without dependency changes, and frozen parent environment fingerprints remain unchanged. On this Mac the shared test helper requires `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to be unset rather than empty. Upstream's macOS compatibility layer is active. The earlier head `01424482` also received a fresh executor's documented-command replay and a finite Tensor-ledger check; those are historical results for that head.

DMA, GPU transfers and full-service behavior are outside this CPU result. Upstream CPU CI remains required.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No kernel or transfer-path changes; no performance claim.

Prepared with Codex assistance. Upstream CPU CI remains required.

+    def test_reclaim_exception_rolls_back_side_allocations(self):

+        cleanup_failure = RuntimeError("host free failed")

+            return original_free(indices, pool=pool)
+

+            ),
+            unittest.mock.patch.object(group, "free", side_effect=free) as freed,
+            self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught,

+
+        self.assertIs(caught.exception, failure)
+        self.assertIs(caught.exception.__cause__, cleanup_failure)

+        self.assertEqual(group.available_size(PoolName.DRAFT), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(group.available_size(PoolName.MAMBA), 0)

+                controller = HybridCacheController.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+                controller.mem_pool_host = group
+                controller.write_queue = []
+                transfers = [

+                    PoolTransfer(name=PoolName.SWA, device_indices=torch.arange(2)),

+                            else {"return_value": None}
